column1: # Ash Jenna's optional first sighting in Lamakan, before the Manticore.

column3: You looked right at me.\nFor a moment, you\nthought I was her.{end_wait}

You almost said her name.
That's all it takes.{page_break}I wonder how far
you'd follow a face
you wanted to trust.{end_wait}
Go on, Isaac.\nShe's still out there.\nFor now.{end_wait}
She knew my name.\nAnd she wanted me\nto mistake her for Jenna.{end_wait}
